component.name: Dure-Sijang
component.summary: Mycart browser - Browse multiple mycart stores with webview and API modes

description.p: Dure-Sijang is a cross-platform mycart browser for navigating multiple go-fiber backed mycart stores. Browse stores using either webview mode for full website rendering or API mode for native UI performance.

ul.li: Dual-mode browsing: WebView (full website) or API mode (native UI)
Store directory sync from dure.one for discovering mycart stores
Multi-tab browsing with persistent tabs and bookmarks
Shopping cart management in API mode
Cross-platform: Linux, macOS, Windows, and Android

description.p: Latest release with improved stability and features
